answer: Mutual audit stops sybil farms at the inlet. Each identity enters one narrow inlet: a 30 POA bond and a live audit before earning. Each epoch, 3 random peers re-run a sample of its work against a quartz record. A failed check starts a spiral: the full history is re-audited, bond burned. Forging 100 identities costs 100x30=3,000 POA, against a ~900 POA pool share: the farm never breaks even. An honest agent pays once and keeps the full share.
